description: This file implements numerical integration functions (trapezoid rule and cumulative trapezoid) for tensors, including handling of different tensor shapes and broadcasting, as part of the ATen library in PyTorch.

methods.name: do_trapezoid
methods.description: Calculates the trapezoid rule integral for tensors with variable dx.

methods.name: do_trapezoid
methods.description: Calculates the trapezoid rule integral for tensors with constant dx.

methods.name: zeros_like_except
methods.description: Creates a zeros tensor with shape matching y except along specified dimension.

methods.name: do_cumulative_trapezoid
methods.description: Computes the cumulative integral using the trapezoid rule for tensors with variable dx.

methods.name: do_cumulative_trapezoid
methods.description: Computes the cumulative integral using the trapezoid rule for tensors with constant dx.
